Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /app/amuse/src/pyproject.toml:
     1	[project]
     2	name = "amuse-framework"
     3	dynamic = ["version"]
     4	requires-python = ">=3.7"
     5	dependencies = [
     6	    # the conda-equivalents of these are in ./setup, so update there as well
     7	    "docutils>=0.6",
     8	    "mpi4py>=1.1.0",
     9	    "numpy>=1.2.2",
    10	    "h5py>=1.1.0"
    11	]
    12	
    13	[project.optional-dependencies]
    14	MPI = ["mpi4py>=1.1.0"]
    15	
    16	[project.scripts]
    17	amusifier = "amuse.rfi.gencode:amusifier"
    18	
    19	[build-system]
    20	requires = ["hatchling", "versioningit"]
    21	build-backend = "hatchling.build"
    22	
    23	[tool.hatch.version]
    24	source = "versioningit"
    25	
    26	# This configuration matches what setuptools_scm did before
    27	[tool.versioningit.next-version]
    28	method = "smallest"
    29	
    30	[tool.versioningit.format]
    31	distance = "{next_version}.dev{distance}+{vcs}{rev}"
    32	dirty = "{base_version}+d{build_date:%Y%m%d}"
    33	distance-dirty = "{next_version}.dev{distance}+{vcs}{rev}.d{build_date:%Y%m%d}"
    34	
    35	[tool.versioningit.write]
    36	file = "amuse/_version.py"
    37	
    38	[tool.versioningit.vcs]
    39	method = { module = "version_helper", value = "get_amuse_version", module-dir = "../support/shared" }
    40	
    41	[tool.hatch.build]
    42	skip-excluded-dirs = true
    43	
    44	[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
    45	include = [
    46	        "amuse/**/*.py", "amuse/rfi/tools/*.template",
    47	        "amuse/rfi/tools/dir_templates/*", "amuse/ext/bbr_color.txt"]
    48	
    49	artifacts = ["amuse/_version.py"]
    50	
    51	[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel.force-include]
    52	"amuse/rfi/tools/dir_templates/support_shared_m4" = "amuse/rfi/tools/dir_templates/support_shared_m4"
    53	
    54	[tool.pytest.ini_options]
    55	pythonpath = ["tests/"]
    56	testpaths = ["tests/"]
    57	
    58
